description: Perth Metropolitan Stormwater Drainage - Pipe (DWER-089) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Water and Environmental Regulation. The Department of Water and Environmental Regulation (DWER) collated stormwater drainage datasets from Local Government Authorities (LGAs) across the Perth metropolitan area as part of a shared funding project between DWER and the Natural Disaster Resilience Program (NDRP). Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Water and Environmental Regulation. Its tags are Channel, Drainage, Drains, Pipe, Stormwater. It offers 5 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, txt, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Government Use). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
